info.name: Admin JLPT backend - authoring to attempt handoff
info.description:
Tasks 1-6 local API handoff. Generated and structurally validated; NOT executed in Postman.
Read admin-jlpt-exams-api.md first. Use only a disposable local/test database: POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE mutate it.
Set baseUrl to the server origin WITHOUT /api/v1 or a trailing slash. Leave credentials out of this file.
Authenticate separately through the existing login/CSRF/cookie flow (or your existing client); paste valid access
tokens into adminToken and studentToken. ADMIN must be a trusted provisioned account; do not infer role from
registration. Requests use Bearer access tokens; refresh manually if expired. The first learner profile request
captures studentUserId. All generated IDs are collection variables. Empty values must be captured before use.
Select actual local PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF and MP3/WAV files in BOTH upload requests before running the workflow.
Do not manually set multipart Content-Type: Postman adds its boundary. Image .jpeg, .png, .webp, .gif only,
10 MiB; audio .mp3 audio/mpeg or .wav audio/wav (also x-wav/wave), 20 MiB. Attachment uses returned IDs.
Run folders 00-06 in order once per new exam. Full question arrays replace answers; retained IDs survive.
The second attempt belongs to the same learner and remains in progress across unpublish and archive.
Archive is SOFT DELETE, with no restore endpoint. The temporary session DELETE physically removes draft content.
Optional negative checks at the end are read-only; they deliberately expect 401/403/400.
No real credentials/tokens, production provider calls, or database secrets are included.
